title: Darwin failed auto-claim leaves successful USB capture unreleased
summary: Successful auto-detach followed by failed raw claim does not restore the system driver; close cannot release an interface never marked claimed.
evidence: findings.md and auto-baseline.log; actual Darwin wrapper regression fails before repair.

resolution.evidence: Task verification.md, quality-review.md and security.md; 36/36 fake USB and ASan/UBSan tests, baseline rollback failure reproduced, normal build dependency dry-run verified. Physical device restoration remains unverified.
